independence_basis: Independent inspection and recomputation of the user-supplied ZIP manifest, draft, token-length report, model configuration, and source-code excerpts. No model inference, conversion, dataset write, cluster authentication, or original source-corpus access.
review_scope: Corpus membership and shared 4,096-token context policy for proposed C/LQ/LO training; this is not training execution approval.

findings.detail: All 1,866 reported source rows partition exactly into 1,858 retained and eight quarantined records with unique source-row IDs and hashes. Seven exceed the 4,096-token cap (six KG, one WebShop); mind2web_60 is quarantined for an empty assistant turn. No other rows meet either exclusion rule.

Retained original-record counts: DB 538, WebShop 350, ALFWorld 336, KG 318, OS 195, Mind2Web 121. The proposed subset is 99.57% of 1,866 source records. All retained report rows have positive full lengths within the proposed cap and no reported empty assistant turns.

The draft changes only max_length 2,048→4,096 for C/LQ/LO. The submitted Llama configuration declares 4,096 maximum position embeddings; the longest retained measured full conversation is 3,949 tokens. This brings 367 otherwise over-2,048 nonempty conversations into proposed whole-record membership. Token counts are from the submitted comparison report, not a freshly repeated native training run.

The policy explicitly disables conversation splitting into overlapping windows, truncation, history rewriting, and empty-response repair. The 1,858 retained rows have distinct source-record hashes and are chosen one-to-one by source row, so full-conversation membership is preferable to overlapping suffix windows for this policy. Actual converted-record identity and native supervision masks remain unverified.

All 13 manifest file SHA-256 checks match the ZIP contents; duplicate report/draft source files match byte-for-byte. The canonical draft/report hashes, source-corpus/report links, model-config object hash and C recipe object hash are consistent with supplied artifacts. Neither raw source conversations nor original remote filesystem is included, so original-content authenticity cannot be independently established.

This approval does not verify clean-source provenance, leakage-free train/validation/test splits, final native training masks or handling of loss=false assistant turns, exact converted training-example equality, 4,096-token memory feasibility, matched C/LQ/LO model controls, or training/execution readiness. The supplied current C recipe still states max_length=2,048 and must be changed and rebound only in a separately reviewed future recipe.

required_future_gates: Verify original source bytes and provenance, enforce proposed record-hash membership at conversion.
Review schema conversion, source-group split independence and final native assistant-loss masks, including loss=false fields.
Freeze identical C/LQ/LO context-policy binding in exact recipes and validate tokenizer/truncation/optimizer resources before any training approval.
